meta.scope: Iraq Batch 3 — Kurdistan Region oil contrast, public-sector wage bill, and exchange-rate densification.

candidates.title: Kurdistan Region oil production and revenue framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from KRG and federal monitoring sources
candidates.description: Statistics and framing of oil production and sales in the Kurdistan Region. Production has typically been in the 250–350 thousand barrels per day range in recent years; sales arrangements, pricing differentials and federal–KRG revenue sharing are recurring points of contention.
referenced_by: Federal oil production and export statistics
candidates.notes: Primary subnational oil densification. Complements federal oil nodes.

candidates.title: Public-sector wage bill and employment statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on public-sector salaries, pensions and related recurrent expenditure. The wage bill absorbs a very large share of federal spending and is a central fiscal pressure point under oil-revenue volatility.
referenced_by: Oil revenue and fiscal sustainability analysis
candidates.notes: High-centrality fiscal-expenditure node under oil dependence.

candidates.title: Exchange-rate and dinar statistics
candidates.description: Official exchange rate for the Iraqi dinar and related FX window operations. The official rate is the central policy price; parallel or informal market premia appear periodically under liquidity or compliance pressures.

candidates.title: Iraq KRG–wage–exchange densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from oil, fiscal and CBI sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding Kurdistan Region oil framing, public-sector wage bill statistics and exchange-rate/dinar statistics into a coherent subnational–fiscal–monetary layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil production, exports, federal budget and BOP series from earlier batches
